name: Find The Button
desc:
[🚨] Disclaimer: This game Saves Your progress, so you can leave the game and complete it Later

👋Welcome To My Find the button Game! Enjoy!

🔎In this game you need to find a hiden button in a Small Room to advance to the next Stage. Challenge Yourself and try to complete this game!
Currently There is a total of 60 Stages

💸Free skip Stage every 20min

🎁Gift a Skip Stage to you friends!

⭐Make sure to like and favorite the game! 👍

📢there is a secret button that teleport you to a secret room and you will get a SECRET BADGE!

A big thanks to jupiter(@Highfoxyplayz11) For helping me
